value.rationale: The theorem is a complete natural two-parameter classification of Hilbert distortion for regular depth-two rooted trees, not a finite test or arbitrary slice. It proves all-optimizer rigidity and the exact optimal affine dimension, and a sharp large-branching constant sqrt(8/3). This quantifies finite-depth structure beyond classical asymptotic tree embedding bounds.
